title: AirflowBatchETL
summary: A batch ETL pipeline project (Jupyter notebooks and scripts) that ingests a sample dataset and builds an Airflow-oriented data flow. Its scripts define table metadata and fit SDV's GaussianCopulaSynthesizer and HMASynthesizer to generate synthetic single- and multi-table data, then check it with SDV's evaluate_quality and run_diagnostic.
